sentences.text: The applicable directions allow a UCB to levy penal charges for default in repayment, but they do not state any maximum rupee amount for one missed EMI in the provided evidence.
The directions say such penal charges must be reasonable and levied only on the amount under default, and they must not take the form of penal interest.
The evidence shows that an overdue instalment can include an EMI that has not been paid in full on its due date, but it does not give a rupee cap for the charge on that missed EMI.

missing.slot: maximum penal charge in rupees for one missed EMI
